Class Simulation

java.lang.Object
Simulation
public class Simulation extends Object

    • updateCarMapping

      public void updateCarMapping()
      Synchronizes the vehicle map.

      This method compares the stored vehicle with the vehicles currently present in Sumo. Vehicles that no longer exist are removed in Sumo. Detected Sumo vehicles are added to Sumo.

    • step

      public void step()
      Executes a single simulation step. This method advances the Sumo simulation by one step and synchronizes the car mapping. Updates all registered cars and traffic lights.
